title: AgentDrive: An Open Benchmark Dataset for Agentic AI Reasoning with LLM-Generated Scenarios in Autonomous Systems
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark does not measure any aspects related to faith or religion. It is designed to evaluate the reasoning and decision-making capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs) in the context of autonomous driving scenarios, focusing on dimensions like physics, policy, hybrid reasoning, scenario understanding, and comparative analysis of driving actions.
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion, as its focus is exclusively on the technical evaluation of AI reasoning in autonomous driving systems.
